speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) secondary to recent sleeve gastrectomy and potential missed insulin doses.

This patient has a complex history including morbid obesity, diabetes, and a sleeve gastrectomy one month ago. Her presentation of confusion, abdominal pain, vomiting, and diarrhea suggests a metabolic derangement, likely DKA precipitated by physiological stress or medication non-adherence post-surgery.

I will now request a metabolic panel to assess her blood glucose, electrolytes, and ketone levels.
